newsitem.title: UK: British Nuclear Fuels says year pre-tax profit up.
newsitem.headline: British Nuclear Fuels says year pre-tax profit up.

text.p: British Nuclear Fuels Plc (BNFL) said on Friday its pre-tax profits, before exceptionals, for the 1995-96 financial year were up by 46 percent, to a record 316 million stg.
Turnover was up by 18 percent to 1,549 million stg, the state-owned company said in a statement.
"Export sales also increased from the record 425 million stg in 1994-95 to 501 million stg," BNFL said, adding this accounted for 32 percent of the year's turnover.
It said operating profits showed an underlying increase of two percent to 233 million stg, while the profit before tax and exceptionals was 316 million stg.

This was because the profit and loss account reflected net financing income this year "due to the repayment of 136 million stg of borrowings, the investment of the previous year's strong cash flows and the group's healthy cash position," it added.
BNFL said an exceptional deferred tax position of 356 million stg, along with other tax charges of 48 million stg, had resulted in a post-tax loss of 88 million stg.
It declared dividends of 93 million stg for the year, against 45 million stg the previous year.
